user_story: As a staff member, I want confirming an already-cancelled booking to return an error so that invalid state transitions are blocked.

positive.title: Confirming an already-cancelled booking returns an error
steps: Navigate to the booking management system.
Select a booking that has a status of 'Cancelled'.
positive.expected_result: The system displays an error message indicating that the booking cannot be confirmed because it has been cancelled.

negative.title: Confirming a non-cancelled booking returns success
steps: Navigate to the booking management system.
Select a booking that has a status of 'Confirmed'.
negative.expected_result: The system confirms the booking successfully and no error message is displayed.

edge.title: Confirming a booking after multiple cancellations
steps: Navigate to the booking management system.
Select a booking that has been cancelled multiple times.
edge.expected_result: The system displays an error message indicating that the booking cannot be confirmed because it is in a cancelled state.
